changelog.en: v1.1.6 build 28: glass intensity 0% no longer hides text and icons (legibility fallback), light-mode wallpaper looks brighter; VOD danmaku arrives (off by default, enable in settings); Douban posters now load at the largest size; Emby support — enter your server address and key in settings, switch to Emby from the video tab, with 4K HEVC, Dolby Vision/HDR, TrueHD, multi-audio and multi-subtitle tracks; settings regrouped into 6 flat groups; music player closes with a swipe down from the top bar; startup auto-update check can be toggled (on by default); smarter private recommendations and heartbeat mode; real-time super-resolution for VOD only (MPV, off by default); video adds skip intro/outro, hold-for-2x, subtitle time shift and dual subtitles, frame interpolation, SDR-to-HDR, DV Profile 8/7, Smart Groups, HD poster completion, Emby Direct Mode, spec badges, TrueHD fallback, full HDR formats, seamless source switching, aggregated Continue Watching, and cross-source episode continuation; danmaku occlusion avoidance for VOD and live; music adds sleep timer, loudness normalization, bookmarks with resume, and an equalizer; live adds danmaku filtering, complete danmaku settings, and quality switches that keep the old picture on failure; the whole app polished to feel like a native iOS app; README rewritten.
changelog.tw: v1.1.6 build 28：玻璃強度 0% 也不再看不清字和圖示（可讀性兜底），淺色桌布更亮了；影視彈幕來了（預設關，設定裡開）；豆瓣封面改取最大檔，清晰多了；接 Emby：設定裡填伺服器位址和 key，影視頁可切 Emby，支援 4K HEVC、杜比視界/HDR、TrueHD、多音軌多字幕；設定頁重排成 6 組平鋪；音樂播放器頂欄下滑可關閉；啟動自動檢查更新可開關（預設開）；私人推薦和心動模式更聰明了；即時超分只給影視點播（MPV，預設關）；影片加了跳過片頭片尾、按住臨時 2x、字幕時間偏移+雙字幕、插幀、SDR 轉 HDR、DV P8/P7、Smart Groups、海報高清補全、Emby Direct Mode、規格徽章、TrueHD 兜底、HDR 全格式、換源無感、聚合繼續觀看、缺集跨源接續；彈幕防遮擋（影視和直播都能用）；音樂加了睡眠定時、音量歸一化、書籤斷點續播、均衡器；直播彈幕過濾、彈幕設定補齊、畫質切換失敗保舊畫面；整 app 按 iOS 原生感覺打磨；README 重寫。
changelog.zh: v1.1.6 build 28：玻璃强度 0% 也不再看不清字和图标（可读性兜底），浅色壁纸更亮了；影视弹幕来了（默认关，设置里开）；豆瓣封面改取最大档，清晰多了；接 Emby：设置里填服务器地址和 key，影视页可切 Emby，支持 4K HEVC、杜比视界/HDR、TrueHD、多音轨多字幕；设置页重排成 6 组平铺；音乐播放器顶栏下滑可关闭；启动自动检查更新可开关（默认开）；私人推荐和心动模式更聪明了；实时超分只给影视点播（MPV，默认关）；视频加了跳过片头片尾、按住临时 2x、字幕时间偏移+双字幕、插帧、SDR 转 HDR、DV P8/P7、Smart Groups、海报高清补全、Emby Direct Mode、规格徽章、TrueHD 兜底、HDR 全格式、换源无感、聚合继续观看、缺集跨源接续；弹幕防遮挡（影视和直播都能用）；音乐加了睡眠定时、音量归一化、书签断点续播、均衡器；直播弹幕过滤、弹幕设置补齐、画质切换失败保旧画面；整 app 按 iOS 原生感觉打磨；README 重写。
